title: Why I had to stop controlling everything
description: Why I had to stop controlling everything
transcript: Even though I was a main driver to build the business to where it's at today, I realized like to get to the next level, I needed to really let my team members, my directors take charge. Even if it takes too long, even if they do it wrong. You would ask me, like, what was like one of the things that I've Learned or one of the things I recommend? And it's like, there's a difference between hiring really great people and enabling really great people. And I think that I've hired really great people. One of my biggest challenges has been enabling them, even if I think what they're doing is wrong or I think they're taking too long. that's probably one thing that I wish someone had told me a while ago and something that I'm still working on today.
